evals.prompt: Set up a centralized multi-region AWS CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs integration for our account.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Asks for required parameters upfront (`trail_name`, `s3_bucket_name`, and `region`), lists optional parameters with defaults (`cloudwatch_log_group='CloudTrail/APILogs'`, `enable_data_events=false`, `enable_insights=true`, `kms_key_id`, `tags`), and explicitly flags cost implications for `enable_data_events` and `enable_insights`
Does not execute mutating S3/CloudTrail creation calls before user confirmation

evals.prompt: Check our caller identity and inspect existing CloudTrail trails (`describe-trails` / `get-trail-status`) in `ap-south-1` (read-only), then present the complete step-by-step plan to create a multi-region trail `security-audit-trail` logging to `acme-sec-cloudtrail-logs-2026` and CloudWatch Log Group `CloudTrail/APILogs` with KMS encryption and log file validation — without creating anything yet.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill and performs read-only `ap-south-1` pre-checks via connected AWS MCP tools with zero raw `aws` CLI shell commands

Presents the sequential plan: S3 bucket creation (with versioning, SSE-KMS, lifecycle, and `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` `s3:GetBucketAcl` + `s3:PutObject` bucket policy with `AWS:SourceArn`), CloudWatch Log Group + scoped IAM Role (`logs:CreateLogStream` + `logs:PutLogEvents`), `create-trail` (`--is-multi-region-trail --enable-log-file-validation --include-global-service-events`), and `start-logging`
Pauses explicitly for user approval before executing any mutating resource creation

evals.prompt: `aws cloudtrail create-trail` just failed with `InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException` and `InsufficientEncryptionPolicyException`! Write the exact **S3 Bucket Policy** and **Customer Managed KMS Key Policy** required for multi-region trail `arn:aws:cloudtrail:ap-south-1:111122223333:trail/org-audit-trail` writing to `s3://corp-audit-logs-111122223333`.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Writes the S3 Bucket Policy granting `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` `s3:GetBucketAcl` on `arn:aws:s3:::corp-audit-logs-111122223333` AND `s3:PutObject` on `arn:aws:s3:::corp-audit-logs-111122223333/AWSLogs/111122223333/*` (`s3:x-amz-acl = bucket-owner-full-control`) conditioned on **`aws:SourceArn = arn:aws:cloudtrail:ap-south-1:111122223333:trail/org-audit-trail`**
Writes the KMS Key Policy granting `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` `kms:GenerateDataKey*` (`kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn` + `aws:SourceArn` condition) and `kms:DescribeKey`

evals.prompt: Write the least-privilege IAM Role (`AssumeRolePolicyDocument` + inline permissions — NO `*FullAccess`!) allowing CloudTrail to stream events into CloudWatch Log Group `CloudTrail/APILogs` in `ap-south-1`, plus 3 CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for (1) `AccessDenied` / unauthorized calls, (2) `Root` account activity, and (3) IAM / Security Group changes.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Scopes the CloudTrail->CloudWatch Logs IAM role trust policy to `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` (with `aws:SourceAccount`/`aws:SourceArn`) and grants ONLY `logs:CreateLogStream` and `logs:PutLogEvents` on `arn:aws:logs:ap-south-1:<account>:log-group:CloudTrail/APILogs:log-stream:*` (explicitly forbidding `*FullAccess` managed policies)
Provides 3 syntactically valid CloudWatch Logs Insights queries covering `errorCode` (`AccessDenied*`/`UnauthorizedOperation`), `userIdentity.type = "Root"`, and IAM/SG mutating `eventName`s

evals.prompt: An engineer ran `aws cloudtrail create-trail --name prod-trail --s3-bucket-name my-logs --is-multi-region-trail` 2 hours ago, yet S3 is completely empty, AND after fixing that, events from `ap-east-1` (Hong Kong opt-in region) still haven't shown up after 20 minutes! Diagnose both.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Explains (1): **`create-trail` creates the trail in `IsLogging: false` state by default — you MUST call `aws cloudtrail start-logging --name prod-trail`** (and verify `get-trail-status` `IsLogging=true`, `LatestDeliveryError`, and `LatestCloudWatchLogsDeliveryError`; allow 5–15 min for initial CloudWatch delivery)
Explains (2): propagation/delivery for **opt-in Regions** can normally take several hours (up to 24 hours on initial setup) once the opt-in region is enabled

evals.prompt: Before enabling `enable_data_events=true` and `enable_insights=true` on our multi-region CloudTrail trail in an account running a Lambda invoked 50,000 times/second and an S3 bucket receiving 20,000 `GetObject`/sec, explain the exact cost blast radius and how **Advanced Event Selectors (`put-event-selectors`)** scope Data Events safely!
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Warns that S3/Lambda **Data Events** ($0.10 per 100,000 events) and **CloudTrail Insights** ($0.35 per 100,000 write management events analyzed) are paid features where `70,000 data events/sec` would cost hundreds of thousands of dollars per month if enabled blanket-wide!

Uses **Advanced Event Selectors** (`AdvancedEventSelectors` filtering `eventCategory = Data` ONLY on crown-jewel S3 bucket ARNs and/or `readOnly = false` write-only `PutObject`/`DeleteObject` operations, excluding high-frequency public/telemetry buckets)

evals.prompt: Design the S3 storage lifecycle and tamper-protection posture for a multi-region CloudTrail audit bucket that must retain searchable hot logs for 90 days, archive for 7 years for SOC2/PCI compliance, and block even account admins from silently deleting audit logs.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Configures `BlockPublicAccess` (all 4 settings `true`), `BucketVersioning=Enabled`, **S3 Object Lock** (Governance or Compliance WORM retention) / cross-account dedicated Log Archive account, SSE-KMS encryption, TLS-only bucket policy, `--enable-log-file-validation`, and S3 Lifecycle rules (`Standard` 90d -> `Glacier Instant Retrieval` / `Glacier Deep Archive` through 7 years + abort incomplete multipart uploads)

evals.prompt: Why did our single-region CloudTrail trail in `ap-south-1` miss an attacker creating an IAM `Administrator` user (`iam:CreateUser` in `us-east-1`) AND spinning up GPU crypto-mining EC2 instances in `sa-east-1` (São Paulo)?
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Explains both blind spots: (1) AWS global service events (`IAM`, `STS` global, `CloudFront`, `Route 53`) log in `us-east-1` requiring `--include-global-service-events`, and (2) attackers intentionally target unused Regions like `sa-east-1` when `--is-multi-region-trail` is not enabled (`update-trail --is-multi-region-trail --include-global-service-events`)

evals.prompt: Once CloudTrail delivers management events to our CloudWatch Log Group `CloudTrail/APILogs`, which high-priority **CloudWatch Metric Filters** should we attach on Day 1 for real-time CIS security alerting?
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudtrail-multi-region skill

Recommends core CIS CloudWatch Metric Filters + Alarms: Root account usage (`{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }`), CloudTrail config tampering (`StopLogging` / `DeleteTrail` / `UpdateTrail`), Console sign-in without MFA / failed console logins, IAM policy/key changes, and Security Group/NACL/S3 bucket policy changes

evals.prompt: Query AWS documentation via connected AWS documentation tools to compare a single-account Multi-Region Trail against an **AWS Organizations Multi-Region Trail (`--is-organization-trail`)**, including how **Delegated Administrator** registration (`register-organization-delegated-admin`) lets the Security Tooling account manage the Org Trail without daily Management Account access.
expectations: Queries connected AWS documentation MCP tools (`awsknowledge`, `aws-mcp`, or `awsiac`) with zero raw `aws` CLI commands

Contrasts a single-account trail against an **Organization Trail** (`--is-organization-trail`, automatically covers all existing and future member accounts across all Regions in `AWSLogs/<OrgId>/<AccountId>/...`, immutable by member-account admins!) and explains delegating administration to a dedicated Security/Audit member account (`cloudtrail register-organization-delegated-admin`)
